text:
sana: FYI Greenfield Labs just pinged — they were charged twice for the annual renewal. Customer attached a PO about 6m after renewal, and our system seems to have created a second invoice instead of linking to the existing one. invoice IDs: INV-2026-9981 (original), INV-2026-9981-2 (duplicate). Amounts both $12,000. :(

jen: ack. Do we have the webhook ordering for the PO attach vs renewal payment? any receipts or charge ids? :eyes:

sana: attaching what the customer sent — they uploaded PO via customer portal at 2026-03-10T14:12Z. Renewal charge processed at 2026-03-10T14:06Z (card). Our webhook logs show PO-attach event processed at 14:13:10 and then our billing worker emitted an "invoice:create" at 14:13:12 which created INV-2026-9981-2.

mike: billing-bot pulled the ledger items and charge events for acct GF-442:
```
SELECT * FROM ledger_events WHERE account_id='GF-442' AND occurred_at BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-03-11';
-- shows two invoice_created rows, two payment_applied rows
```

mike: charge ids: ch_3Kxx1 (card) applied to INV-2026-9981, and po_7639 (PO) created a zero-payment invoice then marked as paid by PO at 14:13:12 which duplicated the invoice record. Looks like our PO flow doesn't dedupe when a recent paid invoice exists for the same billing period.

ricardo: :frowning: Customer is asking for refund and reversal plus a note for audit. We should issue a reversal for the duplicate invoice and refund the second charge to the card if possible. Are both charges settled?

mike: both charges are 'posted' in the ledger. Card payment captured and settled. PO payment is an applied credit (internal). We'll need finance signoff to reverse the PO credit and void the duplicate invoice. I've created internal finance ticket FIN-4882.

jen: can eng reproduce? eng-oncall, could the webhook consumer process PO-attach after invoice TTL expired and then create a fresh invoice instead of linking? This smells like eventual consistency + missing idempotency.

eng-oncall: looking. Quick repro steps: create subscription, wait for auto-renew, then after renewal call /portal/attach_po which emits event po.attached. If billing worker processes po.attached after invoice.lock_ttl (30s), it triggers invoice reconciliation and creates a new invoice. I can reproduce locally with simulated delay. Posting curl to simulate payload: 
```
curl -X POST https://events.redwood.local/po -d '{"account_id":"GF-442","po_number":"PO-7639","attached_at":"2026-03-10T14:13:10Z"}' -H 'X-Signature: sig...' 
```

eng-oncall: root cause: invoice reconciliation job doesn't check for recently paid invoices for same period if the original invoice is in state 'locked' vs 'finalized' — race condition.

sana: customer wants timeline and refund ETA. Ricardo, can finance do emergency reversal today?

ricardo: I'll escalate FIN-4882. For the customer-facing message: we'll refund the duplicate charge to the card immediately and issue a memo reversing the PO credit. ETA 24-48h for refunds to appear. I'll include ledger entries and audit id.

jen: mitigation: temporarily hold processing of po.attached events for 60s in the billing worker for any account with invoice.created within last 5m and add explicit de-dupe by matching subscription and period. Also add an alert when two invoices are created for same period.

mike: added a quick monitoring alert rule: metric invoice.duplicates.count > 0 per account -> paging to eng-oncall. Patch PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/billing/pulls/3129

sana: thanks all. I'll update the customer: refund in progress, internal ticket FIN-4882, engineering patch PR-3129, and we'll follow up when reversal complete. :pray:
